name: P07 #1 — FACE: one grown face at a time, close in, so the head reads and is not argued about.

steps.note: F0. Frame the head, not the body: aim high on the height, and pull in.
F1. Barty alone, close. The gap's clearest doll: was 39.9% head share on a 1.23 u body.
F2. The farmer — the first villager face off the old shared kit (was 'oval' eyes, a line brow).
F3. The baker — same body, so what changed is only the face and the head.
F4. Halvard, the reference for what 'already right' looks like on this kit.
